parameter.value: Ha! Another pair of hands that wants the stone to sing, |PLAYERNAME|? I am Durnok Runebrand. Bring me a {blank rune}, gold and gems and I will {carve} you a rune. Or earn my {respect} and I will teach you the old, mighty ones. New to the craft? Ask me what a {rune} really is.
Strike true and stand tall, |PLAYERNAME|! The mountain remembers those who do not flinch.
Even the finest chisel rests sometimes. Come back when you are ready.
